case.question: Compute Company A's Return on Equity (ROE) for fiscal year 2024 as a percentage, rounded to two decimal places. Use average equity.
case.context: Company A annual report. All financial amounts are in USD millions. Net Profit for fiscal year 2024: 500. Total Equity at the end of fiscal year 2024: 2500. Total Equity at the end of fiscal year 2023: 2200. No other values are reported.
